exposure: mode of delivery (planned vs. emergent cesarean delivery)
outcome: composite maternal morbidity (death, red blood cell transfusion, hysterectomy, reoperation, hospital stay > 7 days, ureteral injury, bowel injury, or cystotomy)
cohort: 140 patients with placenta previa without morbidly adherent placenta
finding: There was no significant difference in composite maternal morbidity between emergent and planned cesarean deliveries for placenta previa without morbidly adherent placenta.
gest_age: 36 weeks for planned c-sections, 34 weeks for emergent c-sections
